iteration_0.solution: Implement the full pipeline: load/synthesize data; initialize agents and multiplex network; implement daily loop (information diffusion, risk update, purchases, mask decisions, policy enforcement); record daily mask adoption; compute metrics including RMSE on days 30–39.

iteration_0.impact: The required direct main() call does not execute, violating the sandbox execution requirement and preventing any run.
iteration_0.solution: Close the Location class docstring and ensure the global main() call is outside any string literal.

iteration_0.issue: Missing core entities (Location attributes/behaviors, Retailer, PublicHealthAuthority, InformationChannel)
iteration_0.impact: Person methods (e.g., purchase_masks) cannot function, and policy/media interactions cannot be simulated. Noncompliance and mask availability metrics cannot be computed.
iteration_0.solution: Define the missing classes with the specified attributes and methods. Wire them into the daily simulation loop.

iteration_0.issue: Watts–Strogatz k parity bug in synthetic network generation
iteration_0.impact: Can cause exceptions in graph generation and fallbacks to inferior random networks, degrading realism of social structure and social influence dynamics.
iteration_0.solution: Ensure k is even and strictly less than n; use a correct transformation to even k.

iteration_0.issue: No calibration or metric computation (including RMSE) for prediction window
iteration_0.impact: The simulation is not fitted to observed data, and predictive accuracy cannot be assessed.
iteration_0.solution: Calibrate coefficients (logistic regression on days 0–29 if train_data.csv exists) and compute RMSE on days 30–39; compute descriptive metrics (peak, sustained, inequality, noncompliance, availability, transmission reduction).

iteration_0.issue: Information diffusion logic uses two independent draws (p_info and epsilon), potentially double-counting seeding
iteration_0.impact: Inflates information adoption and may bias risk perception and mask adoption upward.
iteration_0.solution: Combine probabilities into a single draw p_combined = 1 - (1 - p_info)*(1 - epsilon), then apply decay separately.

iteration_0.issue: Decision and inventory logic disconnect (adoption can be True but inventory prevents wearing without immediate purchase attempt)
iteration_0.impact: Systematically underestimates adoption when stock exists but timing causes failures.
iteration_0.solution: Attempt a purchase before deciding, and/or if adoption is chosen but inventory is zero, attempt immediate purchase; if successful, set mask_status = True.
